split_policy: Reuse the registered 12 training / 4 validation external fixtures. Previously exposed data, not a fresh test. Do not access the four post-freeze fixtures in this selection.
hypothesis: Accumulating symmetric team-control evidence over time reduces incidental-touch fragmentation compared with isolated nearest-player decisions.
abstention: No observed ball or missing team coverage gives neutral evidence; no answer before first evidence, after last evidence or in an entirely unsupported block. Long missing runs split decoding at a training-derived median gap duration.
selection: Mean external provider spell proxy with prediction-X forward fill only inside contiguous known-target blocks, then H/A macro F1. Also report old frozen proxy for direct comparison.
acceptance: Improvement over frozen baseline on mean spell proxy and at least three of four validation fixtures, with no mean H/A macro-F1 loss. Selection remains an external automatic-provider proxy candidate, not validated video or D release.
D: Not inferred from missing coordinates or provider X. Needs independently evaluable live/dead evidence.
source_freeze: Record code, registry, input and target hashes before calibration; store full results before selecting; never use Barcelona pixels, public scores or annotations.
next: Separate visual control and D evaluation; independent final validation before a combined release. No guarantee of competition performance.
